title: KPI methodology frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of kpis/measurement/<kpiId>.md, the human-authored methodology document for one KPI. Human-authored, so it carries no provenance block. Quote date values in YAML so they parse as strings

kpiId.description: KPI this document defines; must equal the file stem

methodVersion.description: Semantic version of the method described; must equal the registry methodVersion for this kpiId. Bump the major on any change that makes old datapoints incomparable

updatedAt.description: Date the document was last revised, quoted as a YAML string

owner.description: Person or agent accountable for the method

inputs.description: Raw input sources the method reads; should match the registry rawInputs sources

status.description: Lifecycle of the method: 'draft' is not yet computed, 'active' is in use, 'deprecated' is kept for historical datapoints only
